why: Image 1 reads as a specific room in use: full record shelves, long-exposure ghosts of patrons and staff, and dimmer, uneven pendant light give it the feel of a real night shoot, even though the blurred figures are a little smeary. Image 2 has warmer depth and nice haze, but its half-empty shelf cubbies, identical stools and even underglow look like an unfinished CG set.
